description: 6 exemplars (one German) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-12 under road-to-account-lifecycle-threat-rows 1.4, which extended this judge's information-disclosure and cryptography-misuse rows and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars are the shape its own description names: a DIFF that may carry security risk, dispatched by a review command. Near-misses are three neighbours that share security vocabulary and answer a different question: the threat model BEFORE the code exists (threat-modeling), the per-entrypoint authorization chain rather than a diff (authz-review), and the agent's own configuration rather than application code (agent-security-review). Counterexamples guard 'security' as a non-technical word — a physical badge policy and a security deposit are not this skill's subject.

queries.q: review this diff for security risk before I merge it
does this change introduce an injection or a mass-assignment hole?
judge the security of the branch — secrets, deserialization, SSRF
this PR touches the login handler; audit what it changed
security pass on these changed files, with findings ranked
prüfe diesen Diff auf Sicherheitsrisiken, bevor ich ihn merge
we are about to build webhook ingest — what are the abuse cases?
walk every endpoint and check the ownership and tenant scope
red-team our agent's MCP and hook configuration
queries.note: agent-security-review audits the agent, not the app

queries.q: what is our policy for issuing building security badges?
how much security deposit should the rental contract ask for?
